_comment: Decision-engine fixture v1: number of bundles per track (issue #3). Rule: docs/mining_system.md §6.7. GPU members and CPU members whose selected algorithm is not best on the track use min_num_bundles. A CPU member whose selected algorithm is best on track t uses bundle_multiple = c / gcd(c, n) and num_bundles[t] = ceil(m / bundle_multiple) * bundle_multiple, the smallest count at or above the protocol minimum with (num_bundles * num_nonces_per_bundle) mod c = 0. Inputs supply selected_algorithm_best_on_track explicitly; that flag is itself derived by §6.5 and is covered by the algorithm-selection family. min_num_bundles and num_nonces_per_bundle mirror get-challenges.json config fields (see README.md). V0 applies no runtime, reward, or fee resizing (§6.7 final paragraph).

cases.name: gpu_member_always_min_num_bundles
cases.description: A GPU member gets min_num_bundles on every track regardless of core counts or best-on-track status.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: 'For a GPU member: num_bundles[t] = min_num_bundles'.

cases.name: cpu_not_best_on_track_min_num_bundles
cases.description: A CPU member whose selected algorithm is not best on the track gets min_num_bundles; the core count is ignored.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: 'For a CPU member when the selected algorithm is not best on track t: num_bundles[t] = min_num_bundles'.

cases.name: cpu_best_cores_divide_nonces_min_stands
cases.description: CPU best-on-track with c = 16 dividing n = 80: gcd(16, 80) = 16, bundle_multiple = 1, so the minimum already aligns and stands.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: bundle_multiple = c / gcd(c, n) = 16/16 = 1; num_bundles = ceil(1/1) * 1 = 1. Check: (1 * 80) mod 16 = 0.

cases.name: cpu_best_partial_overlap_rounds_up_to_multiple
cases.description: CPU best-on-track with c = 16, n = 40: gcd = 8, bundle_multiple = 2, so the minimum of 1 is rounded up to 2 bundles.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: bundle_multiple = 16 / gcd(16, 40) = 16/8 = 2; num_bundles = ceil(1/2) * 2 = 2. Check: (2 * 40) mod 16 = 0.

cases.name: cpu_best_coprime_counts_full_multiple
cases.description: CPU best-on-track with coprime c = 8 and n = 25: gcd = 1, bundle_multiple = 8, so the minimum of 2 is rounded up to a full multiple of 8.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: bundle_multiple = 8 / gcd(8, 25) = 8/1 = 8; num_bundles = ceil(2/8) * 8 = 8. Check: (8 * 25) mod 8 = 200 mod 8 = 0.

cases.name: cpu_best_minimum_above_multiple_rounds_to_next
cases.description: CPU best-on-track with c = 6, n = 40 and a minimum of 4: bundle_multiple = 3, and the smallest multiple of 3 at or above 4 is 6.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: bundle_multiple = 6 / gcd(6, 40) = 6/2 = 3; num_bundles = ceil(4/3) * 3 = 2 * 3 = 6. Check: (6 * 40) mod 6 = 240 mod 6 = 0.

cases.name: cpu_best_single_core_min_stands
cases.description: A single-core CPU member best on track: gcd(1, n) = 1, bundle_multiple = 1, so min_num_bundles always stands.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: bundle_multiple = 1 / gcd(1, 33) = 1; num_bundles = ceil(2/1) * 1 = 2. Check: (2 * 33) mod 1 = 0.

cases.name: cpu_more_cores_than_nonces_per_bundle
cases.description: CPU best-on-track with more cores than nonces per bundle, c = 64, n = 40: gcd = 8, bundle_multiple = 8, so 8 bundles are needed for the nonce total to divide evenly across cores.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: bundle_multiple = 64 / gcd(64, 40) = 64/8 = 8; num_bundles = ceil(1/8) * 8 = 8. Check: (8 * 40) mod 64 = 320 mod 64 = 0.

cases.name: cpu_mixed_tracks_sized_independently
cases.description: One CPU plan across two tracks: the selected algorithm is best on t1 (aligned sizing applies) but not on t2 (minimum applies). Bundle counts are selected separately per track because TIG picks the final track during precommit processing.
cases.rule: mining_system.md §6.7: 'Bundle counts are selected separately for every possible track'. t1: bundle_multiple = 12 / gcd(12, 40) = 12/4 = 3; num_bundles = ceil(2/3) * 3 = 3; check (3 * 40) mod 12 = 0. t2: not best, num_bundles = min_num_bundles = 2.
